content: The service by this app is focused majorly on customers and not on the drivers. Pros: Very good earnings on long distance orders. Cons: Pathetic customer care support Poor app functionalities such as; 1. No real time target updates. 2. No proper fare update for incorrect location specified by customers. 3. Bugs in order acceptance. 4. No goodwill if customer cancels order after arriving pick up location. 5. Waiting time at pick up and drop allowed is too long (30 + 30 minutes)
